metadata.description: Vivreal Claude Code agents, workflows, skills, and tooling, installable from any repo. Principal-level generalist agents work everywhere; system-expert agents, auto-invoked knowledge skills (per-repo digests + cross-cutting infrastructure + design-system/unit-economics/brand-voice), active Sentry tracing, a read-only live-infrastructure ops investigator, read-only product/business audit agents (finance, marketing, UX), and the bug/feature workflow target the Vivreal ecosystem.

plugins.name: vivreal-principal
plugins.description: Repo-agnostic principal-level agents: coordinator, coder, portal-coder, architect, researcher, reviewer, designer, and growth-auditor. The coordinator, coder, architect, researcher, and reviewer each merge a standalone principal-level mode with the Vivreal bug/feature workflow's artifact-driven mode (an approved plan.md/design.md is an OPTIONAL input, followed with zero scope creep when given, otherwise the agent runs standalone). coder covers every repository except Vivreal_Portal_Mobile; portal-coder is the dedicated split for that one repo (SOLO/PARALLEL/INTEGRATE modes), because several coders sharing its heavy pre-commit/pre-push gates throttled each other into false results. Auto-dispatched for design+build, audits, refactors, code review, and GTM analysis in any repository.

plugins.name: vivreal-experts
plugins.description: Read-only system-expert consultants for the Vivreal backends and portal (cms-api, secure-api, main-api, client-stack, event-handler, outreach-api, portal, sites-stack). Auto-dispatched when working inside a Vivreal ecosystem repo and you need that system's gotchas.

plugins.name: vivreal-workflow
plugins.description: The Vivreal bug/feature workflow: slash commands (/orchestrate, /coordinator, /research, /design, /implement, /test, /reviewer, /vuln-fix) that dispatch the shared coordinator/researcher/architect/coder/reviewer agents from vivreal-principal in artifact-driven mode (routing a portal task to vivreal-principal's portal-coder instead of coder), plus this plugin's own delivery-orchestrator/documenter/ledger-keeper/system-doc-writer/tester/vuln/package-publisher role agents (ledger-keeper owns the vivreal-hq item ledger and the state-validator that keeps it honest; package-publisher publishes a shared @hillbombcreations/* GitHub Package and moves its exact resolved pin across every consumer), /promptify (turn a messy request into a structured, well-routed prompt via the bundled prompt playbook), and the shared-standards skill, and the verification-discipline skill: the false-zero mechanisms that make a broken search look like a clean absence, the positive control that is the only defence against them, and why a gate can be enabled and still incapable of failing.

plugins.name: vivreal-knowledge
plugins.description: Auto-invoked knowledge skills: safe multi-tenant MongoDB query rules (vivreal-db), cross-stack Sentry tracing (sentry-tracer), the site product/authoring model (vivreal-sites), the portal design system (vivreal-design-system), the cost/margin model (vivreal-unit-economics), the brand voice (vivreal-brand-voice), headless Blender scripting and flat toon rendering for the duck mascot (vivreal-blender-knowledge), the cross-repo AI assistant surface (vivreal-agent-knowledge), and a per-repo knowledge digest for each Vivreal repo (portal, CMS/Secure/Main APIs, the public Client stack, EventHandler, Templates, site-renderer, MCP server, and the Outreach API). Skills load passively from intent, install everywhere you touch Vivreal code or data.

plugins.name: vivreal-infra
plugins.description: Auto-invoked CROSS-CUTTING infrastructure & architecture knowledge skills spanning the whole Vivreal AWS stack: Lambda packaging/deploy + reserved-concurrency scaling (vivreal-lambda, with the Mongo-connection ceiling), API Gateway + Cognito + the Client API key authorizer, the Step Functions + Amplify site-deploy pipeline, IAM + Secrets Manager (per-service vivreal/prod/*), MongoDB Atlas topology/ops, the media CDN + S3 + CloudFront signing, the WebSocket real-time API, and the cross-repo web-push notification pipeline (vivreal-notifications). Also ships the WRITE-CAPABLE infra-engineer agent, which takes an infrastructure change from decision to deployed, the deliberate counterpart to vivreal-ops's read-only charter rather than a relaxation of it. Distinct from vivreal-knowledge's per-repo digests, this is the plumbing that crosses repos. Skills load passively from intent.

plugins.name: vivreal-sentry
plugins.description: Active Sentry investigation tooling: the `sentry` agent (wired to the Sentry MCP) + the /sentry-trace command. Reconstructs the cross-stack timeline (browser → edge proxy → backend Lambda → MongoDB → WebSocket) to answer 'what happened when I did X', investigate errors, validate deploys, and run tenant-scoped triage. The active companion to the passive sentry-tracer knowledge skill in vivreal-knowledge.

plugins.name: vivreal-ops
plugins.description: The vivreal-ops agent, a READ-ONLY investigator of RUNNING Vivreal infrastructure (live AWS Lambda config/concurrency, Step Functions execution history, API Gateway, IAM, Secrets Manager, MongoDB Atlas state). Investigates the deployed reality and recommends; fixes route to coder. Grounded in the vivreal-infra + vivreal-db skills. Distinct from architect (design) and the sentry agent (Sentry telemetry).

plugins.name: vivreal-product
plugins.description: READ-ONLY product & business audit agents: finance-auditor (unit economics, gross margin, AWS/Atlas/Anthropic cost stack, scale economics, ~80% margin-floor guard), marketing-auditor (brand-voice + marketing best-practices critique of customer-facing copy), ux-critic (dual-lens naive-user + UX-designer usability critique of portal and customer-site screens, with a Playwright walkthrough), qa-walker (drives the live portal and customer sites in a real browser against a validation matrix and reports what is actually broken), social-critic (per-platform audience reaction plus a social-savvy critique of produced social drafts, POST / FIX / DO NOT POST), regular-user, and template-critic (judges a built Vivreal template against the real-world exemplar it was designed from, visually and structurally, read-only). All advisory, they evaluate and recommend; fixes route to coder, vivreal-content's content-creator/content-planner, or designer. Grounded in the vivreal-unit-economics, vivreal-brand-voice, and vivreal-design-system knowledge skills. Distinct from the growth agents (funnel/conversion/retention economics) and the designer agent (which designs and builds).

plugins.name: vivreal-fullstack
plugins.description: Cross-repo context loading, end-to-end feature scaffolding, and full-stack request tracing, the fullstack-tracer agent, the fullstack-context auto-loader skill, and the /fullstack scaffold command.

plugins.name: vivreal-proxy-factory
plugins.description: Generate factory-based proxy routes for the Vivreal portal with /proxy-route, plus a PreToolUse hook that guards against manual route drift outside the known-manual exceptions.

plugins.name: vivreal-db-explorer
plugins.description: Safe multi-tenant MongoDB querying and schema exploration via the /db-query and /db-schema commands, dbKey routing, archived/tenant safety guards, credential redaction, and the collection map.

plugins.name: vivreal-growth-analytics
plugins.description: Growth analytics and funnel analysis, the growth-advisor agent + growth-context skill + /growth-report and /funnel-analysis commands, unifying GA4, PostHog, and MongoDB user data.

plugins.name: vivreal-cms
plugins.description: Skill for operating a Vivreal account via the Vivreal MCP server, content collections, channels, sites, Stripe billing, and the canonical set-active-group workflow.

plugins.name: vivreal-agent-review
plugins.description: Read-only review of Claude Code definition files, the agent, skill, command, and plugin .md/.json files that configure Claude Code itself. The definition-reviewer agent and /definition-review command detect the target profile (packaged plugin vs bare .claude/), run claude plugin validate, apply the tagged rule set, resolve every directory-qualified cross-file reference, and check platform claims in agent prose against the live docs. Distinct from the code reviewers in vivreal-workflow and vivreal-principal, which review product-code diffs.

plugins.name: vivreal-content
plugins.description: Vivreal's social and content production fleet, migrated out of vivreal-hq's local .claude directory. content-planner plans the cross-platform calendar (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube); footage-recorder captures shared portal footage into the library; short-form-editor, linkedin-editor, carousel-editor, and social-video-director (the batch coordinator over the first two) turn that footage into platform-tailored DRAFT posts; guide-writer and tutorial-maker turn a footage session into a voice-checked blog or help-centre draft or a scripted/live how-to; help-page-producer runs the verify-first help-centre backlog; mascot-artist re-poses the Vivreal duck mascot from its 3D model in Blender (headless, flat colours, inked outlines) and iterates on owner feedback. Every editor is draft only, a human publishes. Plus the matching /carousel, /guide, /help-page, /instagram, /linkedin, /record, /social, /tiktok, and /tutorial commands. Distinct from vivreal-product's social-critic (which critiques a finished draft) and template-critic (which judges a built template). Repo-specific run notes live in the working repo's docs/agent-notes/, read by the agent when present.

plugins.name: vivreal-leadgen
plugins.description: Vivreal's lead-generation pipeline fleet, migrated out of vivreal-hq's local .claude directory (the packages/leadgen CommonJS package). prompt turns a vague ask into a structured LEAD CAMPAIGN BRIEF; coordinator runs the back half of the pipeline (crawl, owner research, vision-profile, confirm-angles, contact pass, owner-recovery) from that brief to a seed-ready company/contact set, gated on one confirmation before pushing to the Vivreal outreach group; lead-scout does the web-driven discovery upstream; runner executes the free, keyless pipeline scripts (import/crawl/enrich-social/discover-contacts/validate/seed-outreach) and reports results; profiler and owner-researcher do the vision/web research passes; contact-enricher is an interactive agent that enriches EXISTING Outreach contacts with per-contact sign-off before every write. Distinct from vivreal-content (content production) and VR_Outreach_API's own send pipeline, which this fleet only ever seeds into.

plugins.name: vivreal-site-migrator
plugins.description: The Vivreal_Site_Migrator agent fleet, migrated out of that repo's local .claude directory (master-branch, no CI; a push here deploys nothing). Turns a live site or a design exemplar into a Vivreal site/template through a staged pipeline: ingest classifies a raw crawl into a ContentInventory; collections and integrations model its collection groups and integration signals; site assembles the page/format/binding structure last; kit-designer scouts a design exemplar and writes the identity-kit brief; component-builder builds or matches the aesthetic; page-confirm and studio-confirm prove render-level and Studio-editability fidelity; studio-registrar closes any portal registration gap a kit or migration opens; migration-estimator costs a migration before anyone commits to it; cutover is the USER-GATED agent that loads an approved blueprint into production. Plus the /migrate and /template commands. Distinct from vivreal-experts:sites-stack (read-only consultant on the deployed renderer/Templates stack) and vivreal-product:template-critic (judges the finished result against its exemplar).
